Record Class ExtractedSongMetadata

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.dto.ExtractedSongMetadata
Record Components:
file - the source audio file on disk
title - track title (tag value, falling back to the file name)
albumTitle - album title (falls back to the track title for singles)
artistRaw - raw artist tag value, possibly multiple names separated by , ; &
genreRaw - raw genre tag value, possibly multiple genres separated by , ;
releaseYear - parsed release year, or null if absent/unparseable
trackNum - track number, defaulted to 1 when absent or invalid
durationSeconds - track length from the audio header
bitRate - bit rate from the audio header
sampleRate - sample rate from the audio header
channels - channel count, normalized to an integer
codec - encoding type from the audio header
fileFormat - uppercase file extension, e.g. "MP3"
fileSizeBytes - file size in bytes
artworkBytes - embedded cover art bytes, or null if none present
contentFingerprint - SHA-256 hash of normalized title+artist+duration — a path-independent identity for this song, used to recognise it again if the file moves or is imported again from a different session/machine
public record ExtractedSongMetadata(File file, String title, String albumTitle, String artistRaw, String genreRaw, Integer releaseYear, int trackNum, int durationSeconds, int bitRate, int sampleRate, int channels, String codec, String fileFormat, long fileSizeBytes, byte[] artworkBytes, String contentFingerprint) extends Record
Everything read from one audio file in a single pass by SongMetadataExtractor.

This record is the reason the import pipeline no longer needs a separate "reconcile metadata" phase: it carries both the fields the old SongImportService.importSong used to read AND the fields the old LibraryMigrationService.syncMetadata used to read, because both were reading the same file anyway.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
